questions: Should the regression line be plotted with confidence intervals (the default in seaborn.regplot) or without them?
What should be the visual style (e.g., color, marker) of the scatter points and regression line?
Should the function set a title or axis labels, or leave the plot completely default?
How should the function handle NaN/inf values in the specified columns? Should it drop, error, or let seaborn handle silently?
What is the expected behavior if the DataFrame contains the columns but all values in one column are constant (zero variance)?
Should the plot be displayed (e.g., with plt.show()) or only the Axes object returned?
Is the order of columns (col1 vs col2) significant? Specifically, is col1 always the x-axis and col2 the y-axis?
